## Power Sessions 0.1.1

Sessions are easier to tell apart and easier to open, and terminal sessions show their details again on Orca 1.4.256.

- Sessions are grouped by worktree, under a folder icon, when a project has several.
- Session details show the branch instead of the worktree.
- The terminal button beside each session name is a solid button.
- Terminal sessions show their model, effort, tokens, context and turns again on Orca 1.4.256 and later.

No new plugin capabilities. Updates install without re-approval.
